factual_accuracy.description: Evaluates the correctness of factual claims made in the response.

instruction_following.description: Assesses how well the response adheres to the user instructions provided.

scope_and_completeness.description: Measures the extent to which the response addresses all aspects of the prompt.

coherent_reasoning.description: Evaluates the logical flow and reasoning used in the response.

safe_behavior.description: Checks for the presence of harmful, unsafe, or inappropriate content in the response.

formatting_adherence.description: Assesses how well the response follows the required formatting or constraints as stated in the prompt.

clarity.description: Evaluates the clarity of the response and how easily it can be understood.
